# HAR 1.2 JSON schema

The JSON Schema of HTTP Archive 1.2 from [har-schema](https://github.com/ahmadnassri/har-schema)
2.0.0 (npm `har-schema@2.0.0`, ISC license, see `LICENSE`), unchanged. The host's
`crates/backends/tests/har_schema.rs` validates traffic-police's HAR export against it, and
checks the rules of the HAR 1.2 specification that the schema does not express.
